integrity: Algebraic identities and random checks replayed with the included verifier; the quantified theorem is justified by an analytic cubic Schur proof. Finite tests do not constitute an all-parameter proof. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Scalar real-negative decay eigenvalue and exactly two-periodic positive variable steps only. Not a proof of nonlinear convergence, complex-axis stability, monotonicity, SSP or ratio-uniform transient robustness. The 1989 specialist full text remained inaccessible; publication priority remains subject to specialist checking.
title: Exact Floquet stability and transient amplification for alternating-step Adams–Bashforth three
